factual_extraction.geographic_context: The river lies wholly in Kazakhstan. Section 3.1.5 describes headwaters on the northern slopes of Keregetas and Zhaman-Karazhal in southeastern Karaganda region, with the river ending at Korgalzhino Lake. It separately treats the connected wetland/lake cascade through Tengiz.
factual_extraction.reach_context: Samarkand Reservoir to Intumak Reservoir is identified as a Nura River segment; Oshagandy, Sherubai-Nuru and Sokyr are separate incoming rivers.
factual_extraction.length_scope: River to Korgalzhino Lake in the 2002 assessment; not assumed equivalent to the lake-linked system extending to Tengiz.
